sentences.text:
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor takes notice  for respondent No.1 and seeks time to get instructions in the matter.
Issue notice to respondent No.2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner herein/A1 is permitted to take out personal notice on respondent No.2 by registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service before the Registry within a period of three (3) weeks.
List the matter after six (6) weeks.

Learned counsel for the petitioner herein/A1 would submit that the petitioner herein/A1 filed a complaint against the defacto complainant and the ..contd., same is registered as FIR No.67 of 2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406, 323, SL.
OFFICE DATE ORDER NO. NOTE ...contd., 312, 313, 316 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry 2nd page Prohibition Act, 1961 at IT Corridor PS, Cyberabad of Telangana State.

In pursuance of the same, the defacto complainant resorted in filing the present complaint against the petitioner herein/A1 and others as a counterblast to the complaint filed by her, on the accusation that she has taken away certain jewelry and idol of one Goddess Lakshmi Devi, which were meant for occasions like Varalakshmi Vratham.
Except the said accusation, there is no other specific accusation against the petitioner herein/A1 to connect her to the offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 IPC.
Therefore, there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings in CC No.44 of 2024 on the file of the learned VI Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Vijayawada, for a period of eight (8) weeks.
